nodes.name: Read cloud space
nodes.notes: Connect this node to the BACKUP SERVER, where rclone credentials live. It can differ from the target VPS. Capacity failure does not invalidate a completed backup.

nodes.name: Telegram
nodes.notes: Add a Telegram bot credential and chat ID, then enable this node. Disable Discord or Telegram independently.

nodeGroups.name: Complete backup
nodeGroups.description: Backs up the selected VPS, checks success and prepares a summary with cloud capacity.
